Carry note from the spec half's contract review · 2026-11-06T00:43Z

The spec half (PR #30727, delta review 6673435245, PASS) makes the `option` formatter refuse when the caller hands it no label table for the hole's `object.field`: `formatValue` throws a `RangeError` carrying `optionTableRefusal(...)` (exported from `@objectstack/formula`).

Until this card lands, plugin-email reaches that refusal as a bare `RangeError` from `formatValue` (template-engine.ts L161), outside the `TEMPLATE_INVALID` vocabulary the `IEmailService` contract states; `sendTemplate` rethrows it (email-service.ts L1607) and nothing is sent.

What this card owes on top of the label-table prefetch and per-recipient render: ask `optionTableRefusal` before `formatValue` and prefix `TEMPLATE_INVALID`, the same way plugin-email already asks `currencyDefaultRefusal` (template-engine.ts L147). An empty option list (`{}` in the table) answers `null` from the formula side and is this card's `TEMPLATE_INVALID` to decide, not the formatter's.

Landing order: the seat holds #30727 until this card's PR is green, then lands the spec half first and this one right after.

Shipped: the server half of ruling F. A mail template's `{{ stage | option:opportunity.stage }}` prints each recipient's option label in their own language, a scheduled flow running as the system included. A missing object, a missing field or an empty option list refuses the whole send with `TEMPLATE_INVALID`. It landed back to back with the spec half, PR #30727 (#30172), so the window where such a template saved but failed at send is closed. The skills line stays with #30731.
